claims.text: A max of 0 on a number field is honoured by the field settings validation: defining a number field with min above 0 and max 0 is rejected when saving the collection.
A number field with max 0 enforces that limit on record values, rejecting any value above 0 on create and update.
Valid number field settings (min <= max, or max omitted) are still accepted, and in-range values are stored unchanged.
